title: CmdPal: Apps (0): Prerequisites (2) - Add icon theme and contrast context

review.body_prefix:
### Qualified current-revision assessment

The contrast snapshot, theme notifications, icon protocols, cache identity and IconBox refresh lifecycle were reviewed. Initialization has one application-launch caller on the palette UI thread, before dock windows are created; no concurrent initialization caller was established. Contrast resource lookup is on settings changes, not the per-icon hot path. The IconBox dispatcher hop preserves the possibility that a control belongs to another window dispatcher.

No additional actionable defect was established. Locking a hypothetical second initialization, caching ResourceContext without a qualifier-refresh design, or unconditionally removing dispatcher marshalling are not supported corrections to the current call paths.

**Validation scope:** The complete changed source/tests and relevant callers were read. The exact x64 Debug UI test project built with analyzers enabled and all 158 selected contrast/protocol/cache tests passed. No interactive high-contrast/theme switch, multi-window visual comparison or full product signoff is claimed. This is a qualified assessment, not an unconditional approval.
